notes.title: Plastic Tactics Online Demo Pre-Release
notes.notes:
Battle your friends in this light-hearted and humorous action-packed turn-based shooter, starring the little green army men we all know and love! Hone your tactical mastery and shooting skills in this fast-paced battle for living room supremacy - face off with both friend and foe alike to prove your mastery of Plastic Tactics Online!

Outwit, Outmaneuver, Outlast
Go head to head and control your soldiers to knock your opponents out of the battlefield.  Capture weapons and leverage your abilities to see if you can outwit your opponents and conquer the battlefield! Can you manage your resources? Choose the right weapon from your arsenal?  Can you get into position to finish your foes off before they get you?

Key Features
Plastic Tactics Online is a 3rd person turn based strategic shooter for up to 4 players- test your tactics in a battle of wits, skills and silly weapons.
